next_assignments.engine:
Expose a small, host-safe capability/phase contract for the existing typed
continuation API, starting with already selected non-Rise observation and Rise
work. Reuse durable parent/phase identities, actual reservations, source rules
and CAS persistence. The App needs actor-safe availability, status, supported
commands and received phase outcomes without private dependency certificates.
Publish the minimal stable API early, then qualify actual decision reads,
rejection, competing resources, pause/resume/cancel, restart and restore. Follow
with the existing communication/offer participant and received-source contracts.
This advances DEV-06–DEV-17 within named scope; their broader completion stays open.
Do not export Rise travel/stock rules as universal campaign mechanics.
next_assignments.app:
Add a bounded common player control/HTTP bridge for existing Engine process
continuation, beginning with qualified non-Rise observation and Rise work.
Use Engine-owned capabilities and its typed prepare/execute/receipt contracts;
authenticate actor and actual branch/restore/revision, show explicit commands,
and persist the candidate save/result atomically before acknowledgment. Preserve
phase identity and original result through pause/resume, failed save, concurrent
retry, restart and restored branches. Render only legitimate received progress.
Where capability discovery needs an Engine contract, record that exact dependency
and continue host/status/recovery work against its existing typed API; invent no
operation or time rule. Communication/source controls follow published contracts.
Protected operator/launcher configuration remains a separate runnable-system item.
next_assignments.catalog:
Add a separately versioned compatibility follow-up for the currently integrated
Engine/App pair, with actual local_responses and saved presentation checks in
independently initialized non-Rise and Rise contexts. Preserve existing fixture
manifests, payload hashes and declared consumer commits exactly; do not repin old
evidence. Select clean exact current consumers and verify App's committed pins.
Test real outcomes, drafts that submit nothing, actor/oracle separation, zero
provider calls, stable older receipts, retries and failed/missing-source fallback.
The current-pair follow-up can proceed now. Extend phase/communication evaluation
only after owner-published contracts supply supported behavior and known facts.
Keep the depot at 750 system variants, 250 editable drafts and 32 recipes unless
the user changes that request. New text alone completes no simulation system.
